Banh mi with fresh jalapenos
Pho bánh mì spring roll advertisement
Came back and tried the other popular dish, garlic noodles with lemongrass beef; while it’s good, I still prefer the Banh Mi. Service was great both times. …
Grilled pork banh mi sandwich
Banh mi with pickled vegetables

Seriously love the banh mi here, tried a few, even the chicken and avocado one was amazing, the chicken was tender and perfectly seasoned. The drinks are also amazing including the egg viet coffee. The pho also is delicious

They start selling food at 11 AM!!! We came early and tried coffee, then got banh mi. It was huge and packed with filling. I tried the pork one and it was really good, but I couldn’t finish it. The place is clean and minimalistic, and the service is good and helpful.
Banh xeo and spring rolls
The found was delicious, we had the veggie banj xeo and the r17 plate and we ate it all up!
Banana bread with butter and sugar

Yum yum yum! This is one of my favorite places to go. I’ve never had a bad meal here- everything is consistently great. My favorite item is the cheeseburger; it’s perfectly cooked every time. We also tried the banana bread for the first …
